commit.message:
fix(browser): resolve the named GLM composer on multi-textbox surfaces + verified replace

Live defects (2026-09-19, host 35420702684.1, session paprika1):

D-K1 — supervisor wake livelock. The signed-in chat.z.ai conversation
surface renders an auxiliary unnamed textbox next to the real composer
(live capture: 'Send a Message' node 1770 + unnamed node 1864). Every
exactly-one-textbox consumer failed closed: the keepalive wake send
looped WAKE_PENDING -> WAKE_AMBIGUOUS -> WAITING every tick for 2h48m
with zero ambiguous_history growth, zero consumed wakes and a transient
last_error — invisible in every durable projection. resolveAgentPlatform
Composer now prefers the uniquely NAMED textbox on multi-textbox
surfaces (fail-closed otherwise, unnamed auxiliaries never win); the
lifecycle core, bootstrap readiness, ambiguity continuation, rollover,
composerMatches and the mesh route through it.

D-K2 — silent draft accumulation. Ctrl+A + Input.insertText is not a
reliable replace on the React-controlled composer: the selection is
dropped between dispatches and each 'replace' APPENDED (live: the fleet
composer accumulated four unsent task prompts, ~10k chars, which a page
reload then submitted as one garbage message). SEMANTIC_TYPE on the GLM
lane now verifies the replace by AX-value readback with one bounded
Delete-escalation retry; a submit-path replace that cannot be proven
fails closed BEFORE Enter so no corrupted multi-prompt text can ever be
sent. Receipts carry replace_verified + hash-only value readback. The
legacy ChatGPT operator lane keeps its historical unverified contract.

D-K3 — silent livelock observability. sendWake pre-effect failures now
record a durable last_send_error (at/wake_id/reason/clicked/failure_
count) and a wake_send_failure_count streak, projected into the state
row; a permanent retry loop can no longer present as idle WAITING.

Tests: glm-composer-resolution-verified-type-repair.test.mjs (14
contract tests: resolver matrix incl. the live two-textbox shape,
lifecycle e2e on that surface, durable failure diagnostics, verified /
escalation-repaired / fail-closed replaces, append-mode reporting,
legacy-lane invariance). Full suite 2400 pass / 0 fail / 2 skip.
